Home.feature_rarity_description: A card’s rarity reflects the species’ real conservation status: the more threatened it is, the rarer it is to pull.
Home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about how the game works before you start.
Home.faq_free_a: Yes. Creating an account is free, and you can collect cards and farm coins without spending any money.
Home.faq_getCards_a: By opening boosters with your coins. Each pack contains 5 randomly drawn cards, revealed one by one.
Home.faq_rarity_a: There are six rarities, from common to mythic. They come from each species’ conservation status on the IUCN Red List: a least-concern species is common, a critically endangered one is legendary, and a species extinct in the wild is mythic.
Home.faq_farm_a: Every card you own earns coins continuously, and the higher its rarity, the more it earns. Earnings keep building while you’re offline and are credited on your next visit.
Home.faq_duplicates_a: Each extra copy of a card raises the quantity shown in your binder and also earns coins: a duplicate is never wasted.
Home.faq_fairness_a: Yes. Draws are computed on the server using odds specific to each booster, and can’t be tampered with from your browser.
Home.faq_profile_q: Are my profile and collection public?
Home.faq_profile_a: Your call. You can make your profile visible to everyone with a bio, a banner and a showcase card, or keep it private from the settings.
